card.name: The word cross in cross-sensitivity
card.fires_on: The word "cross" (or the hyphen and "react" right after it) in cross-sensitivity, cross-reactivity and cross-hypersensitivity in allergy warnings. It also fires weakly on words meaning effects carry over, such as "carry" and "to" after transfer.

modes.label: Cross- allergy terms
modes.description: "cross" or "-react" starting a word about shared allergy between drugs.
modes.example: There is no information regarding<< cross>>-hypersensitivity between fluconazole

modes.label: Transfer or carry-over
modes.description: A word that sets up an effect spreading from one area to another.
modes.example: building critical thinking skills that will<< carry>> over into all aspects of their classroom performance

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about crossing over or being unrelated, and away from unrelated vocabulary.
card.plain: It lights up on "cross" in cross-sensitivity or cross-reactivity between drugs, and on words about effects carrying over.
